tagline: The UAE's capital trades Dubai's flash for grand landmarks: the white-marble Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, the Louvre Abu Dhabi's floating dome and the presidential palace of Qasr Al Watan.
overview: Abu Dhabi was a modest pearling and fishing settlement until oil wealth transformed it after the 1960s. As capital of the seven-emirate federation, it grew into a city of wide boulevards, Corniche beaches and island districts planned on a monumental scale.

Its landmarks are among the Gulf's most striking. The Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, built from gleaming white marble with 82 domes and over a thousand columns, is one of the world's largest mosques. On Saadiyat Island, the Louvre Abu Dhabi's silvery dome filters light into 'rain' over galleries bridging East and West, and the gold-domed Emirates Palace and the presidential palace Qasr Al Watan show off the city's ceremonial side.

For thrills, Yas Island packs in Ferrari World, home of the world's fastest roller coaster, Warner Bros. World and the Yas Marina Formula 1 circuit. Quieter escapes include kayaking the city's mangroves and desert safaris into the golden dunes towards the Empty Quarter.

funFacts.title: THE CAPITAL, NOT DUBAI
funFacts.text: Abu Dhabi, not Dubai, is the capital of the United Arab Emirates and the largest of its seven emirates.

funFacts.title: A GRAND MOSQUE
funFacts.text: The Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque can hold over 40,000 worshippers and contains one of the world's largest hand-knotted carpets.

funFacts.title: THE LOUVRE OF THE DESERT
funFacts.text: The Louvre Abu Dhabi, opened in 2017, was the first universal museum in the Arab world, topped by a 180-metre dome.

funFacts.title: THE WORLD'S FASTEST COASTER
funFacts.text: Ferrari World's Formula Rossa launches riders to 240 km/h, making it the fastest roller coaster on Earth.

funFacts.title: A PALACE YOU CAN VISIT
funFacts.text: Qasr Al Watan, the working presidential palace, opened its great halls and library to visitors in 2019.

funFacts.title: FALCONS GET THEIR OWN HOSPITAL
funFacts.text: The Abu Dhabi Falcon Hospital is the largest of its kind, treating the UAE's national bird.

funFacts.title: A MAN-MADE MANGROVE
funFacts.text: The city's Eastern Mangrove park is a protected habitat for flamingos, herons and turtles minutes from downtown.

funFacts.title: SEVEN STARS?
funFacts.text: The Emirates Palace hotel reportedly cost around $3 billion to build and has its own gold-dispensing ATM.

funFacts.title: OIL MADE IT
funFacts.text: Before oil was found in 1958, Abu Dhabi survived on pearl diving, fishing and camel herding.

funFacts.title: AN F1 FINALE
funFacts.text: The Abu Dhabi Grand Prix at Yas Marina has hosted season-deciding Formula 1 title battles under floodlights.
